name: ctx-mod
description: Proactive context management: a task ledger, a searchable history and zero-summary window switches.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the plugin on without the CTX_MOD=1 environment variable. CTX_MOD wins when set: 1 turns it on, 0 turns it off. Off by default, so an unconfigured install behaves as before.

compactWindow.title: Assumed window (tokens)
compactWindow.description: The context window assumed when the engine reports no auto-compact threshold.

boundaryTokens.title: First reminder (tokens)
boundaryTokens.description: Context fill, in tokens, at which the first reminder fires: switch at the next task boundary.

softTokens.title: Second reminder (tokens)
softTokens.description: Context fill, in tokens, at which the second reminder fires: record progress as you go and switch at the next task boundary.

urgentTokens.title: Third reminder (tokens)
urgentTokens.description: Context fill, in tokens, at which the third reminder fires: prepare to switch at once.

cooldownRequests.title: Cooldown (model requests)
cooldownRequests.description: Model requests that must pass between two window switches. 0 lifts the cooldown.

maxSwitchesPerHour.title: Switches per hour
maxSwitchesPerHour.description: Window switches allowed in one rolling hour. 0 approves none.

coldMinTokens.title: Cold-cache switch above (tokens)
coldMinTokens.description: With an expired cache, the context fill above which a prompt is held back and the window switched first.

gateMinTokens.title: Load gate above (tokens)
gateMinTokens.description: Context fill above which a load that would rebuild the cached prefix switches the window first. The same group is held back once per window.
